name: Pipelines - Simplified Upgrade Experience
description: In order to gain productivity boosts with AI in Fabric Data Factory, you can now easily upgrade your existing ADF factories to Fabric in a super easy friction-free way. Previously we had multi-step processes that were run from button clicks in ADF. Now your existing ADF factories can be automatically bridged from Fabric trial capacities and then easily upgraded as-is to native Fabric pipelines and data flows.
